description: Cancel an in-flight Fast Research run for a notebook. RPC-backed. Fire-and-forget: the server does not validate the run id, so `cancelled: true` means the cancel was sent; confirm with research_sources. `run_id` defaults to the notebook’s current research task.

run_id.description: The research task id (as research_sources returns). Defaults to the current task.

name: cancel_research

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
